title: VIXEN configure should discover Undertow root without a manual environment variable
body: The documented Release configure/build command failed before compilation because VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt required UNDERTOW_ROOT. Re-running with UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/gpuspeed restored configuration and allowed the target build. Consolidate repository-pair discovery or emit a supported queued setup so every lane does not hand-wire the consumer root.
